name: get_world_model
title: get_world_model
description: Returns a cached JSON snapshot of the project the editor currently has open: the live scene tree (node names, paths, types, attached scripts, groups, sub-scene boundaries), the editor's state (open scenes, selection, whether a playtest is running) and an inventory of res:// scenes and scripts. Call this before any edit; the 'revision' field increments whenever the project changes underneath you.

refresh.description: Rebuild even if the cache is still valid. Only needed if you suspect an external tool changed the project.

include_properties.description: Include each node's non-default property values. Off by default because it multiplies the response size.

include_signals.description: Include incoming and outgoing signal connections per node.

include_instanced_children.description: Descend into instanced sub-scenes. Those nodes are not editable from the parent scene, so this is for inspection only.

include_filesystem.description: Include the res:// scene and script inventory.

max_depth.description: Stop descending after this many levels (-1 = unlimited). Truncated branches report 'hidden_children'.

max_files.description: Cap on the number of files listed per category.

revision.description: Bumps on every project mutation. Use it to detect stale reads.

cached.description: True when served from cache without a rebuild.

path.description: Absolute path of the project directory.

scene.description: Null when no scene is open in the editor.

path.description: Path relative to the scene root; the root itself is '.'. This is the form every other tool expects.

script.description: res:// path of the attached script, or null.

unique_name.description: Present and true when the node is marked %-accessible.

instance_of.description: Present when this node is an instance of another scene.

hidden_children.description: Children omitted due to max_depth or sub-scene boundaries.

properties.description: Only present with include_properties; only non-default values are listed.
